entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling about an order. I bought this jersey a while ago, and I'm just so confused about what to do.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I have your name or order number? And can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

Oh, my name is Mark Peterson. The problem is it's the wrong size. I finally tried it on and it's just way too tight across the chest. The website was a bit overwhelming and I think I clicked the wrong thing.

I understand, Mark. Thank you for that information. Let me just pull up your account... One moment... Okay, I see your order here from about 35 days ago for the Aero-Vent jersey. So, the fit is the main issue?
Yes, exactly. It's too tight. I wanted to see if I could exchange it, but I looked at the return page and there were all these different rules and dates... I got lost. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I'm happy to simplify it for you. Let me just check the policy for that specific item... Okay, good news. That jersey is a standard apparel item, which falls under our 10-day return and exchange policy.
Oh, 10 days? Really? That's a relief. So I'm not too late?

Not at all. You are well within the timeframe. We can definitely process an exchange for you to get the correct size, or I can process a return for a full refund if you'd prefer. What works best for you?
An exchange would be perfect. I really like the jersey, it was just the wrong size that was the problem.

Excellent. I have initiated the exchange in our system for one size larger. I'm sending an email to you right now that contains a prepaid return shipping label and instructions. Once our warehouse receives the original jersey, the new one will be sent out immediately.
Wow, that's it? That's so much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Diana, you've been a huge help.
You're very welcome, Mark! I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
My pleasure. Have a great day and enjoy the new jersey when it arrives!
